title: Canonical derived evaluation commutes with open restriction
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an open, and K,N objects in its specified derived category [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume a specified derived category on the over-site of U in the same morphism universe w. On the scheme U.toScheme use the standard localization (morphism universe u+1). Let E be the derived functor of Modules.overEquiv U [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], with the shared SheafOfModules category instances, and R the composite of exact over-site restriction with E. Let H_X and H_U be the fixed derived internal Hom functors [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], D=H_X(K,1_X), K_U=RK, N_U=RN, and D_U=H_U(K_U,1_U). Define g_X and g_U as the canonical adjuncts of the respective associator; identity tensor evaluation; right unitor composites using [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection] and [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. There exist isomorphisms a:R(N tensor D)≅N_U tensor D_U and b:R(H_X(K,N))≅H_U(K_U,N_U) such that R(g_X);b.hom=a.hom;g_U. This statement has no chosen local complexes, no Hom exactness or dual flatness hypothesis, and no ordinary evaluation arrow.

proof.text: Obtain the compatible strong monoidal structure on the composite restriction functor and the internal-Hom comparisons, with the uncurrying equation. The construction includes the independent localization universes.

Map the tensor unit by the inverse unit comparison u:R(1_X)≅1_U. Set d=h(K,1_X) followed by H_U(id,u), a=the inverse tensorator on (N,D) followed by id tensor d, and b=h(K,N). Naturality of the canonical bijection in its first and third variables and the uncurrying equation for id_D show d.hom whisker RK followed by evaluation on U equals the tensorator on (D,K) followed by R(evaluation on X) and u.hom. Apply injectivity of the canonical bijection on U to the desired square. Its two sides uncurry to identical morphisms by the preceding counit identity, associator naturality, monoidal associativity, tensorator naturality, and right-unit coherence. These calculations are proved in the private Lean helper closedMonoidal_evaluation.

proof_origin.description: P4 factors out the mixed-universe closed monoidal comparison construction, and proves the final dual-evaluation square by a generic categorical calculation in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_canonicalEvaluation_open_restriction (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K N : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    let E := (Equivalence.functor
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ E
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace) X.sheaf
    let HU := derivedInternalHom
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) U.toScheme.sheaf
    let KU := R.obj K
    let NU := R.obj N
    let D := H.obj (op K, 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X))
    let DU := HU.obj (op KU, 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme))
    let g := ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv X) (N ⊗ D) K N).symm
      ((α_ N D K).hom ≫ N ◁
        ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv X) D K (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X)) (𝟙 D)) ≫
          (ρ_ N).hom)
    let gU := ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv U.toScheme) (NU ⊗ DU) KU NU).symm
      ((α_ NU DU KU).hom ≫ NU ◁
        ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv U.toScheme) DU KU
          (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme)) (𝟙 DU)) ≫ (ρ_ NU).hom)
    ∃ a : R.obj (N ⊗ D) ≅ NU ⊗ DU,
      ∃ b : R.obj (H.obj (op K, N)) ≅ HU.obj (op KU, NU),
        R.map g ≫ b.hom = a.hom ≫ gU
